title: Better than expected!
text: Better than expected!. I bought two different draft stoppers from two different companies and this one is far superior!  Nice quality!

product_metadata.title: Door Draft Stopper,YOOGO 36 Inch Under Door Draft Blocker for Bottom of Door,Weighted Under Door Draft Noise/Wind/Light/Air/Dust/Odor Blocker for Apartment Door Gap Filler Bottom,Fabric Draft Guard
features: [Multi-Function] The door draft stopper can keep dust, pests, wind and polluted air out of the door, and also can effectively block excessive noise and light through the cracks of your bedroom at night. The weight of 3.1lbs ensures its stability, which is not easily blown away by the wind. Also, the 36 inches length of under door draft stoppers are suitable for any windows or doors.

[All Seasons Protection] The weighted draft stopper also has the function of heat & cold insulation. The door draft stopper helps prevent exterior drafts, which is more efficient to heat and cool your home. Not only save energy but also save your electricity bills.

[Safe Materials & Durable] YOOGO under door blocker utilizes soft soundproof plugs packed with PED cotton and glass beads to add weight, which is specially designed for durability and sturdiness. The glass beads can ensure a tight seal and block the air out of the door. The door draft stopper also can be utilized as home decoration to bring comfort to your family.

[Easy Storage] The weighted door draft stopper has a double stain cord, which is convenient for you to hang it in the closet, coat rack or door handle. Also, YOOGO draft stopper comes with a fabric package bag, which can keep it out of dust when not in use.

[Convenient to use] The under door draft stopper is super easy to install without using any tools. Just attach two hook tapes in parallel on the inside part of the door bottom, and then stick the door draft stopper to the hook tapes. Measure the gap to select the suitable size or consult our customer service. Please NOTE: Do not place the stopper too close to the floor for better stickiness.
